## Problem

What are you trying to do that the app does not support today?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Scope notes

- Does this affect the overlay OBS loads, the generator, or both?
- Would it touch a permanence-sensitive route (`/multichat`, `/counter`)?
  Those URLs live in scene collections and must not change behaviour for
  existing viewers.
